observed_problem: A repository-wide fresh-chat audit disproved any claim that a new native ChatGPT conversation could be called perfectly inherited from repository evidence. The parent canonical DELIBERATION_POLICY allowed risk-adaptive research while COMMON_CAPABILITIES still froze the older every-problem-research rule; the executable binding validator ignored child CAPABILITIES despite BINDING_POLICY declaring those checks; CURRENT_SYSTEM duplicated volatile child head/profile/CI observations and had already become stale relative to at least Financial. Child capability profiles also carried stale copied cognition semantics.

evidence: src/uaos/integrations/binding.py previously accepted no capabilities/common-capabilities arguments
tests/integrations/test_binding_policy.py previously froze only adapter/manifest/skill validation
config/COMMON_CAPABILITIES.json still required research/reflection for every detected problem
Financial/A-share/Video capability profiles retained copied old cognition rules
CURRENT_SYSTEM declared itself derived but duplicated per-child commit/profile/CI observations
Financial current child main had advanced beyond the parent snapshot
tests froze duplicated snapshots as parent contracts even though DOMAIN_HEALTH_INDEX says current child authority wins

competing_root_hypotheses.reason: Native host mediation remains a real assurance boundary, but repository-internal binding and semantic contradictions were reproducible before host behavior is considered.
The parent COMMON_CAPABILITIES owner also carried stale cognition semantics and the parent executable binding gate did not inspect capabilities.

Canonical cognition ownership changed without semantic-copy retirement, capability inheritance was declared but not mechanically validated, and derived parent projection retained volatile child current-state mirrors.

Selector routing, direct-domain ownership, parent/child authority hierarchy, runtime finalization and existing control boundaries remain independently coherent; current evidence supports a bounded inheritance/control-plane refactor rather than a whole-system rewrite.

selected_parent_changes: Make executable BindingPolicy validate manifest, adapter, skill, capabilities, common capability contract floors, required common capability IDs and current deliberation-policy inheritance.
Reject child capability profiles that copy/freeze a parent cognition algorithm instead of referencing the canonical DELIBERATION_POLICY owner.
Remove the stale fixed research floor from COMMON_CAPABILITIES and delegate risk-adaptive search semantics to DELIBERATION_POLICY.
Compact CURRENT_SYSTEM into an owner/pointer/bounded-assurance projection and remove per-child current commit/profile/CI copies.
Add semantic cross-owner reconciliation tests in addition to timestamp freshness.
Expand fresh-chat integration tests from router selection to the complete parent-side binding handshake for every registered domain.

first_candidate_ci.finding: Eight regressions were old tests that froze per-child CURRENT_SYSTEM mirrors or the retired every-problem-research floor; new executable binding logic itself was not the failure source.

child_reconciliation_plan: After parent promotion, update each registered child owner-natively so CAPABILITIES references current COMMON_CAPABILITIES and DELIBERATION_POLICY without copying the parent cognition algorithm; run child CI and production reread; then refresh DOMAIN_HEALTH_INDEX cache from current child authority.
assurance_boundary: Repository traversal and CI can prove the repository-controlled bootstrap, selector, binding and owner-reference contracts. They cannot prove a native ChatGPT new conversation always receives or obeys the bootstrap pointer, because CHATGPT_GITHUB has no verified repository-controlled pre-send/bootstrap hook. Do not claim perfect fresh-chat execution on native ChatGPT from repository evidence alone.
